title: Cyclic Arbitrage in Decentralized Exchanges
motivation: DEX markets exhibit price discrepancies enabling cyclic arbitrage, but lack systematic study of trader behavior
problem_framing: Formalize profitability conditions and optimal trading volume for cyclic arbitrage in constant product AMMs
key_insight: Atomic smart contract execution enables cyclic arbitrage without price impact loss—blockchain tech unlocks novel trading strategies
method_signature: Theoretical CPMM arbitrage model + empirical Uniswap V2 transaction-level data analysis
evaluation_criteria: Exploitable opportunity count, total revenue, gas cost ratio, success rate of atomic vs sequential implementation
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Most profitable unexploited opportunity persistently exceeds 1 ETH, indicating market inefficiency—traders cannot capture available profit
evidence_for_taste: revenue of the most profitable unexploited opportunity is persistently higher than 1 ETH
market size of exploited cyclic arbitrage is significantly smaller than the exploitable opportunities
only 0.03% of traders submit trades sequentially
atomic implementations could mitigate users' financial loss
DEX markets may not be efficient enough
thinking_moves: 从价格差异出发定义利润函数，求导找最优交易量
将多池交易等价为单一虚拟池来简化分析
理论条件→实际数据验证，测量市场效率差距
区分实现方式(sequential vs atomic)来揭示技术优势
